Hi First Name,

This is the weekly sweep of every North Shore property that passes a development screen. 222 sites qualified this week from 1,852 in scope across the 34 suburbs I track. 37 are Ray White stock and 173 are other agency stock.

A site qualifies one of two ways. Either the zone permits multiple units and the land area clears the floor for that suburb, or the listing copy markets the site to developers outright. Every card says which path it took.
Read this first
Land area is the Trade Me figure. It is not title verified this issue, because the Relab cache was empty for this run.

Zones come from the Auckland Council zone layer, resolved from the Trade Me map pin. Only 6 of the 222 carry a zone confirmed by a second source. A marketing pin is not a surveyed title point, so read a single source zone as a lead and not as a fact.
The Development Sales Register holds no records yet, so the benchmark line on every card below prints as unavailable. Nothing here is estimated, because nothing is estimated at all.

What is not in this issue
Six sections of the standard brief are held back this week rather than filled with estimates.
This week in numbers, land value benchmarks by suburb, recent development site sales, exit market and active buyers all rest on the Development Sales Register, which holds no records yet.
Planning and zoning needs two weekly snapshots of the Council zone layer to produce a diff. Only one snapshot exists, so the first real diff is possible next week.
Each returns automatically the week its data exists.
Two ways to use me
I keep an off market register of North Shore development sites that never reach a portal. I also run feasibility and land value on a site you already hold or are about to bid on.
